pipelines.name: Publish .NET SDK to NuGet

steps.name: Compute next version
steps.run:
CURRENT=$(git tag -l 'sdk-dotnet/v*' | sed 's|sdk-dotnet/v||' | sort -V | tail -1)
CURRENT=${CURRENT:-0.0.0}

# A tag appears only when the release PR merges, so a changelog top
# version ahead of the newest tag means the last release merged
# untagged. Stop, rather than emit a second section for it.
TOP=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-top-version.sh dotnet/CHANGELOG.md)
if [[ -n "$TOP" && "$TOP" != "$CURRENT" \
      && "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$TOP" "$CURRENT" | sort -V | tail -1)" == "$TOP" ]]; then
  echo "::error::dotnet/CHANGELOG.md top v${TOP} is ahead of the latest sdk-dotnet/v* tag v${CURRENT}; create the missing tag and retry."
  exit 1
fi

NEW=$(./.github/scripts/bump-version.sh "$BUMP" "$CURRENT")

echo "new-version=${NEW}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# The release-pr job checks out without full history, so generate the
# section here and hand it over as a job output.
ROW=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.id == "dotnet")' .github/sdk-releases.json)
mapfile -t PATHS < <(jq -r '.paths[]' <<<"$ROW")
SECTION=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-for-release.sh "$NEW" sdk-dotnet "${PATHS[@]}")
{
  echo 'section<<SECTION_EOF'
  printf '%s\n' "$SECTION"
  echo 'SECTION_EOF'
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{
  echo "## .NET SDK release plan"
  echo ""
  echo "- bump type: \`${BUMP}\`"
  echo "- current: \`${CURRENT}\`"
  echo "- new: \`${NEW}\`"
  echo "- tag: \`sdk-dotnet/v${NEW}\`"
  echo "- dry-run: \`${DRY_RUN}\`"
  echo ""
  echo "### Changelog section"
  echo ""
  printf '%s\n' "$SECTION"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

git config user.name 'grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]'
git config user.email '144369747+grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

steps.name: Update CHANGELOG.md
steps.run:
printf '%s\n' "$SECTION" > /tmp/section.md
./.github/scripts/prepend-changelog.sh dotnet/CHANGELOG.md < /tmp/section.md

{
  echo "The .NET SDK \`${NEW_VERSION}\` is already published to NuGet. This PR records its changelog entry."
  echo ""
  cat /tmp/section.md

  echo "---"

  echo "Merging this PR creates \`sdk-dotnet/v${NEW_VERSION}\` via \`tag-releases-on-merge.yml\`."
} > /tmp/pr-body.md

pipelines.name: Publish JS SDK to npm

steps.name: Bump version
steps.run:
CURRENT=$(node -p "require('./js/package.json').version")
CORE_CURRENT=$(node -p "require('./js-core/package.json').version")

# A tag appears only when the release PR merges, so a changelog top
# version ahead of the newest tag means the last release merged
# untagged. Stop, rather than emit a second section for it.
LATEST=$(git tag -l 'sdk-js/v*' | sed 's|sdk-js/v||' | sort -V | tail -1)
LATEST=${LATEST:-0.0.0}
TOP=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-top-version.sh js/CHANGELOG.md)
if [[ -n "$TOP" && "$TOP" != "$LATEST" \
      && "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$TOP" "$LATEST" | sort -V | tail -1)" == "$TOP" ]]; then
  echo "::error::js/CHANGELOG.md top v${TOP} is ahead of the latest sdk-js/v* tag v${LATEST}; create the missing tag and retry."
  exit 1
fi

(cd js && npm version "$BUMP" --no-git-tag-version --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts >/dev/null)
NEW=$(node -p "require('./js/package.json').version")
(cd js-core && npm version "$NEW" --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts >/dev/null)

echo "new-version=${NEW}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# Prepend before packing so the published tarball ships the entry.
# The section also travels to the release-pr job, which has no full
# history to regenerate it from.
ROW=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.id == "js")' .github/sdk-releases.json)
mapfile -t PATHS < <(jq -r '.paths[]' <<<"$ROW")
SECTION=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-for-release.sh "$NEW" sdk-js "${PATHS[@]}")
printf '%s\n' "$SECTION" | ./.github/scripts/prepend-changelog.sh js/CHANGELOG.md
{
  echo 'section<<SECTION_EOF'
  printf '%s\n' "$SECTION"
  echo 'SECTION_EOF'
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{
  echo "## JS SDK release plan"
  echo ""
  echo "- bump type: \`${BUMP}\`"
  echo "- current: \`${CURRENT}\`"
  echo "- core current: \`${CORE_CURRENT}\`"
  echo "- new: \`${NEW}\`"
  echo "- tag: \`sdk-js/v${NEW}\`"
  echo "- dry-run: \`${DRY_RUN}\`"
  echo ""
  echo "### Changelog section"
  echo ""
  printf '%s\n' "$SECTION"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Pack tarball
steps.run:
mkdir -p tarballs
# The [0-9] glob keeps the main-package pattern from also matching
# the core tarball (grafana-agento11y-core-*.tgz).
(cd js && pnpm --config.ignore-scripts=true pack --pack-destination ../tarballs)
mv tarballs/grafana-agento11y-[0-9]*.tgz tarballs/sdk-js.tgz
(cd js-core && pnpm --config.ignore-scripts=true pack --pack-destination ../tarballs)
mv tarballs/grafana-agento11y-core-*.tgz tarballs/sdk-js-core.tgz

steps.name: Install npm with Trusted Publishing support
Publish to npm
steps.run:
# Preflight both tarballs first so a registry/auth error on the new
# core package is caught before the full SDK version is burned.
# --provenance attaches SLSA build provenance via OIDC (id-token: write).
npm publish ./tarballs/sdk-js-core.tgz --access public --ignore-scripts --provenance --dry-run
npm publish ./tarballs/sdk-js.tgz --access public --ignore-scripts --provenance --dry-run

# Publish the new (less-proven) package first. If it fails the run
# can be retried without leaving an orphan @grafana/agento11y
# release on npm.
npm publish ./tarballs/sdk-js-core.tgz --access public --ignore-scripts --provenance
npm publish ./tarballs/sdk-js.tgz --access public --ignore-scripts --provenance

steps.run:
git config user.name 'grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]'
git config user.email '144369747+grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

steps.name: Bump package versions and update CHANGELOG.md

printf '%s\n' "$SECTION" > /tmp/section.md

{

pipelines.name: Publish plugins to npm

steps.name: Setup Git
steps.run:
git config user.name 'grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]'
git config user.email '144369747+grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

steps.name: Resolve plugin list
Bump, build, and pack each plugin
steps.run:
mkdir -p tarballs
PLUGINS=$(echo "$PLUGINS_JSON" | jq -r '.[]')
BUMP_SUMMARY=""
for p in ${PLUGINS}; do
  echo "::group::Preparing plugins/${p}"

  ROW=$(jq -r --arg id "$p" '.[] | select(.id == $id)' .github/sdk-releases.json)
  CHANGELOG=$(jq -r '.changelog' <<<"$ROW")
  TAG_PREFIX=$(jq -r '.tag_prefix' <<<"$ROW")
  mapfile -t PATHS < <(jq -r '.paths[]' <<<"$ROW")

  # A tag appears only when the release PR merges, so a changelog top
  # version ahead of the newest tag means the last release merged
  # untagged. Stop, rather than emit a second section for it.
  LATEST=$(git tag -l "${TAG_PREFIX}/v*" | sed "s|${TAG_PREFIX}/v||" | sort -V | tail -1)
  LATEST=${LATEST:-0.0.0}
  TOP=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-top-version.sh "$CHANGELOG")
  if [[ -n "$TOP" && "$TOP" != "$LATEST" \
        && "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$TOP" "$LATEST" | sort -V | tail -1)" == "$TOP" ]]; then
    echo "::error::${CHANGELOG} top v${TOP} is ahead of the latest ${TAG_PREFIX}/v* tag v${LATEST}; create the missing tag and retry."
    exit 1
  fi

  (cd "plugins/${p}" && npm version "${BUMP}" --no-git-tag-version --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts)
  NEW=$(node -p "require('./plugins/${p}/package.json').version")
  NAME=$(node -p "require('./plugins/${p}/package.json').name")
  echo "Plugin ${p}: ${NAME}@${NEW}"

  # Generate the changelog and prepend it to the plugin's CHANGELOG.md
  # before packing, so the published tarball ships the new entry.
  # Stash the section in /tmp for the release PR body (same job, so the
  # working tree and /tmp persist into the next step).
  SECTION=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-for-release.sh "${NEW}" "$TAG_PREFIX" "${PATHS[@]}")
  printf '%s\n' "$SECTION" > "/tmp/changelog-${p}.md"
  printf '%s\n' "$SECTION" | ./.github/scripts/prepend-changelog.sh "$CHANGELOG"

  pnpm --filter "${NAME}" run build
  (cd "plugins/${p}" && pnpm --config.ignore-scripts=true pack --pack-destination "../../tarballs")

  # pnpm pack output is e.g. grafana-agento11y-pi-0.18.0.tgz; rename to <plugin>.tgz
  # so the matrix step doesn't need to know the version.
  for f in "tarballs/"*"${p}-"[0-9]*.tgz; do
    mv "$f" "tarballs/${p}.tgz"
    break
  done

  BUMP_SUMMARY="${BUMP_SUMMARY}- ${NAME}@${NEW}\n"
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

{
  echo "## Plugin release plan"
  echo ""
  echo "- bump type: \`${BUMP}\`"
  echo "- dry-run: \`${DRY_RUN}\`"
  echo ""
  echo "Versions:"
  printf "%b" "${BUMP_SUMMARY}"
  for p in ${PLUGINS}; do
    echo ""
    echo "### Changelog: plugins/${p}"
    echo ""
    cat "/tmp/changelog-${p}.md"
  done
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Prepare release PR
steps.run:
PLUGINS=$(echo "$PLUGINS_JSON" | jq -r '.[]')
BUMP_SUMMARY=""
for p in ${PLUGINS}; do
  NAME=$(node -p "require('./plugins/${p}/package.json').name")
  NEW=$(node -p "require('./plugins/${p}/package.json').version")
  BUMP_SUMMARY="${BUMP_SUMMARY}- ${NAME}@${NEW}\n"
done

TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
echo "branch=release/plugins-${TIMESTAMP}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{
  printf '## Plugin version bumps\n\n'
  printf '%b\n' "${BUMP_SUMMARY}"
  for p in ${PLUGINS}; do
    NAME=$(node -p "require('./plugins/${p}/package.json').name")
    printf '\n---\n\n**%s**\n\n' "${NAME}"
    cat "/tmp/changelog-${p}.md"
  done
  printf '\n---\n\n'
  echo "Merging this PR creates the \`plugins/<name>/v<version>\` tags via \`tag-releases-on-merge.yml\`."
} > /tmp/pr-body.md

pipelines.name: Publish Homebrew Formula

steps.name: Resolve tag and version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Manual runs must pass an explicit tag; only tag-triggered
# pushes can derive it from GITHUB_REF.
if [[ -n "$INPUT_TAG" ]]; then
  TAG="$INPUT_TAG"
elif [[ "${GITHUB_REF:-}" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
  TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
else
  echo "::error::Input 'tag' is required when dispatching this workflow manually."
  exit 1
fi
case "$TAG" in
  plugins/agento11y/v*) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::Refusing to publish '$TAG'; expected a plugins/agento11y/v* tag."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
VERSION="${TAG#plugins/agento11y/v}"
# Homebrew users should only ever see stable releases in the tap;
# skip SemVer pre-releases (version containing a hyphen, e.g.
# 0.12.0-rc.1).
if [[ "$VERSION" == *-* ]]; then
  echo "Tag '$TAG' is a pre-release; skipping tap publication."
  echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
{
  echo "tag=${TAG}"
  echo "version=${VERSION}"
  echo "branch=agento11y-${VERSION}"
  echo "skip=false"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Compute source tarball sha256
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# The slashes in the tag are fine here; GitHub serves source
# tarballs for slashed tags at the same refs/tags path.
TARBALL_URL="https://github.com/${GH_REPO}/archive/refs/tags/${TAG}.tar.gz"
echo "Fetching: ${TARBALL_URL}"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o source.tar.gz "${TARBALL_URL}"
SHA256="$(sha256sum source.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')"
if [[ ! "${SHA256}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::computed sha256 is not 64 hex chars: '${SHA256}'"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Computed sha256=${SHA256}"
echo "sha256=${SHA256}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

steps.name: Render formula from template
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
TMPL=".github/homebrew/agento11y.rb.tmpl"
if [[ ! -f "${TMPL}" ]]; then
  echo "::error::template missing at ${TMPL}"
  exit 1
fi
# Restricting envsubst to these two variables keeps the Ruby
# #{...} interpolations in the template intact. The single quotes
# are deliberate: envsubst takes the variable list literally.
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
envsubst '$VERSION $SHA256' < "${TMPL}" > agento11y.rb
# Sanity-check the rendered formula:
grep -q "^class Agento11y < Formula" agento11y.rb \
  || { echo "::error::bad formula render (missing class header)"; exit 1; }
grep -q "sha256 \"${SHA256}\"" agento11y.rb \
  || { echo "::error::sha256 not substituted"; exit 1; }
grep -q "version \"${VERSION}\"" agento11y.rb \
  || { echo "::error::version not substituted"; exit 1; }
grep -q "/archive/refs/tags/plugins/agento11y/v${VERSION}.tar.gz" agento11y.rb \
  || { echo "::error::version not substituted into URL"; exit 1; }
grep -q "bin.install_symlink \"agento11y\" => \"sigil\"" agento11y.rb \
  || { echo "::error::sigil compatibility symlink missing"; exit 1; }
echo "Rendered agento11y.rb:"
echo "---"
cat agento11y.rb
echo "---"
echo "rb_path=${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/agento11y.rb" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

steps.name: Stage formula in tap
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Flat-layout tap: agento11y.rb goes at the root, next to alloy.rb
# and grafana.rb, NOT under Casks/.
cp "${RB_PATH}" tap/agento11y.rb

pipelines.name: Publish Python SDKs to PyPI

steps.name: Setup Git
steps.run:
git config user.name 'grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]'
git config user.email '144369747+grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

steps.name: Compute and apply version bump
steps.run:
PACKAGE_DIRS=(
  python
  python-providers/openai
  python-providers/anthropic
  python-providers/gemini
  python-frameworks/langchain
  python-frameworks/langgraph
  python-frameworks/openai-agents
  python-frameworks/llamaindex
  python-frameworks/google-adk
  python-frameworks/litellm
  python-frameworks/pydantic-ai
  python-frameworks/deepeval
  python-frameworks/harbor
  python-frameworks/strands
  python-frameworks/claude-agent-sdk
  plugins/hermes
)

TARGET=python
if [[ "$PACKAGE" != all ]]; then
  TARGET=
  for dir in "${PACKAGE_DIRS[@]}"; do
    name=$(grep '^name = ' "${dir}/pyproject.toml" | head -1 | sed 's/name = "\(.*\)"/\1/')
    if [[ "$name" == "$PACKAGE" ]]; then
      TARGET=$dir
      break
    fi
  done
  if [[ -z "$TARGET" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Unknown Python package: ${PACKAGE}"
    exit 1
  fi
fi
CURRENT=$(grep '^version = ' "${TARGET}/pyproject.toml" | head -1 | sed 's/version = "\(.*\)"/\1/')

if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all || "$PACKAGE" == agento11y ]]; then
  # A tag appears only when the release PR merges, so a changelog top
  # version ahead of the newest tag means the last release merged
  # untagged. Stop, rather than emit a second section for it.
  LATEST=$(git tag -l 'sdk-python/v*' | sed 's|sdk-python/v||' | sort -V | tail -1)
  LATEST=${LATEST:-0.0.0}
  TOP=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-top-version.sh python/CHANGELOG.md)
  if [[ -n "$TOP" && "$TOP" != "$LATEST" \
        && "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$TOP" "$LATEST" | sort -V | tail -1)" == "$TOP" ]]; then
    echo "::error::python/CHANGELOG.md top v${TOP} is ahead of the latest sdk-python/v* tag v${LATEST}; create the missing tag and retry."
    exit 1
  fi
fi

NEW=$(./.github/scripts/bump-version.sh "$BUMP" "$CURRENT")
echo "new-version=${NEW}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all || "$PACKAGE" == agento11y ]]; then
  ROW=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.id == "python")' .github/sdk-releases.json)
  mapfile -t PATHS < <(jq -r '.paths[]' <<<"$ROW")
  SECTION=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-for-release.sh "$NEW" sdk-python "${PATHS[@]}")
  printf '%s\n' "$SECTION" > /tmp/section.md
  printf '%s\n' "$SECTION" | ./.github/scripts/prepend-changelog.sh python/CHANGELOG.md
fi

{
  echo "## Python SDK release plan"
  echo ""
  echo "- package: \`${PACKAGE}\`"
  echo "- bump type: \`${BUMP}\`"
  if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all ]]; then
    echo "- core current: \`${CURRENT}\`"
    echo "- core new: \`${NEW}\`"
  else
    echo "- current: \`${CURRENT}\`"
    echo "- new: \`${NEW}\`"
  fi
  echo "- dry-run: \`${DRY_RUN}\`"
  if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all || "$PACKAGE" == agento11y ]]; then
    echo "- tag: \`sdk-python/v${NEW}\`"
    echo ""
    echo "### Changelog section"
    echo ""
    printf '%s\n' "$SECTION"
  fi
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all ]]; then
  mapfile -t DEPENDENTS < <(for dir in "${PACKAGE_DIRS[@]:1}"; do grep '^name = ' "${dir}/pyproject.toml" | head -1 | sed 's/name = "\(.*\)"/\1/'; done)
elif [[ "$PACKAGE" == agento11y ]]; then
  DEPENDENTS=()
else
  DEPENDENTS=("$PACKAGE")
fi
printf 'dependents=%s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "${DEPENDENTS[@]}" | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

for dir in "${PACKAGE_DIRS[@]}"; do
  if [[ "$PACKAGE" != all && "$dir" != "$TARGET" ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  file="${dir}/pyproject.toml"
  VERSION=$NEW
  if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all && "$dir" != python ]]; then
    current=$(grep '^version = ' "$file" | head -1 | sed 's/version = "\(.*\)"/\1/')
    VERSION=$(./.github/scripts/bump-version.sh "$BUMP" "$current")
  fi
  sed -i "s/^version = \".*\"/version = \"${VERSION}\"/" "$file"
  if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all && "$dir" != "python" && "$dir" != "plugins/hermes" ]]; then
    sed -i "s/\"agento11y>=.*\"/\"agento11y>=${NEW}\"/" "$file"
  fi
  if [[ "$dir" == plugins/hermes ]]; then
    echo "hermes-version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  fi
  echo "  updated ${file} to ${VERSION}"
done
if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all || "$PACKAGE" == agento11y ]]; then
  (cd python && uv --no-config lock)
fi
if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all || "$PACKAGE" == agento11y-hermes ]]; then
  (cd plugins/hermes && uv --no-config lock)
fi

steps.name: Build distributions
steps.run:
PACKAGE_DIRS=(
  python
  python-providers/openai
  python-providers/anthropic
  python-providers/gemini
  python-frameworks/langchain
  python-frameworks/langgraph
  python-frameworks/openai-agents
  python-frameworks/llamaindex
  python-frameworks/google-adk
  python-frameworks/litellm
  python-frameworks/pydantic-ai
  python-frameworks/deepeval
  python-frameworks/harbor
  python-frameworks/strands
  python-frameworks/claude-agent-sdk
)

for dir in "${PACKAGE_DIRS[@]}"; do
  pkg_name=$(grep '^name = ' "${dir}/pyproject.toml" | head -1 | sed 's/name = "\(.*\)"/\1/')
  if [[ "$PACKAGE" != all && "$PACKAGE" != "$pkg_name" ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  echo "Building ${pkg_name} from ${dir}..."
  python -m build "$dir" --outdir "dist/${pkg_name}"
done
if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all || "$PACKAGE" == agento11y-hermes ]]; then
  bash plugins/hermes/scripts/run-check.sh build --expected-version "${{ steps.bump.outputs.hermes-version }}" --output-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist/agento11y-hermes"
fi
python -m twine check --strict dist/*/*

steps.name: Build release PR body
steps.run:
if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all || "$PACKAGE" == agento11y ]]; then
  {
    if [[ "$PACKAGE" == all ]]; then
      echo "Releases the Python packages, including \`agento11y\` at \`${NEW_VERSION}\`."
    else
      echo "Releases \`agento11y\` at \`${NEW_VERSION}\`."
    fi
    echo ""
    cat /tmp/section.md
    echo ""
    echo "---"
    echo ""
    echo "Merging this PR creates \`sdk-python/v${NEW_VERSION}\` via \`tag-releases-on-merge.yml\`."
  } > /tmp/pr-body.md
else
  echo "Releases \`${PACKAGE}\` at \`${NEW_VERSION}\` without changing the shared Python SDK changelog or tag." > /tmp/pr-body.md
fi

with.add-paths:
python/CHANGELOG.md
python/pyproject.toml
python/uv.lock
python-providers/*/pyproject.toml
python-frameworks/*/pyproject.toml
plugins/hermes/pyproject.toml
plugins/hermes/uv.lock

pipelines.name: Release plugins/agento11y binaries

steps.name: Resolve tag and version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Manual runs must pass an explicit tag; only tag-triggered
# pushes can derive it from GITHUB_REF.
if [[ -n "$INPUT_TAG" ]]; then
  TAG="$INPUT_TAG"
elif [[ "${GITHUB_REF:-}" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
  TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
else
  echo "::error::Input 'tag' is required when dispatching this workflow manually."
  exit 1
fi
case "$TAG" in
  plugins/agento11y/v*) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::Refusing to release '$TAG'; expected a plugins/agento11y/v* tag."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
# VERSION carries the leading `v` (e.g. v0.9.0). GoReleaser strips
# that to produce {{ .Version }} = 0.9.0.
VERSION="${TAG#plugins/agento11y/}"
echo "tag=${TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Extract release notes from CHANGELOG.md
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# The script prints its own reason for each failure mode and errexit
# fails the step, so there is nothing to add here.
notes=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-latest-section.sh plugins/agento11y/CHANGELOG.md)
delim="$(openssl rand -hex 16)"
{
  echo "RELEASE_NOTES<<${delim}"
  printf '%s\n' "$notes"
  echo "${delim}"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Point GoReleaser at a local v* tag
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# GORELEASER_CURRENT_TAG is the prefix-stripped name (v0.44.0).
# The real git tag is plugins/agento11y/v0.44.0. GoReleaser 2.18+
# reads tag contents and fails if that fake name is missing.
git tag -f "$VERSION"

steps.name: Create GitHub Release
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# {{ .Version }} in the goreleaser config drops the leading `v`,
# so the archive names use the bare semver.
BARE_VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
# Windows archives are .zip (format_overrides in the goreleaser
# config); everything else is tar.gz.
assets=(
  "dist/agento11y_${BARE_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
  "dist/agento11y_${BARE_VERSION}_linux_arm64.tar.gz"
  "dist/agento11y_${BARE_VERSION}_darwin_amd64.tar.gz"
  "dist/agento11y_${BARE_VERSION}_darwin_arm64.tar.gz"
  "dist/agento11y_${BARE_VERSION}_windows_amd64.zip"
  "dist/agento11y_${BARE_VERSION}_windows_arm64.zip"
  "dist/agento11y_${BARE_VERSION}_checksums.txt"
)
for asset in "${assets[@]}"; do
  if [[ ! -f "$asset" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Expected asset is missing: $asset"
    exit 1
  fi
done

if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # Re-release: refresh notes and overwrite existing assets.
  gh release edit "$TAG" \
    --title "$TAG" \
    --notes "$NOTES"
  gh release upload "$TAG" --clobber "${assets[@]}"
else
  # --verify-tag makes gh check the tag exists on the remote
  # before creating the release; the release is automatically
  # pinned to the commit the tag points at.
  gh release create "$TAG" \
    --title "$TAG" \
    --notes "$NOTES" \
    --verify-tag \
    "${assets[@]}"
fi

steps.name: Setup Git
steps.run:
git config user.name 'grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]'
git config user.email '144369747+grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

steps.name: Compute next version
steps.run:
CURRENT=$(git tag -l 'plugins/agento11y/v*' | sed 's|plugins/agento11y/v||' | sort -V | tail -1)
CHANGELOG_FROM=""
if [[ -z "$CURRENT" ]]; then
  # First release after the plugins/sigil -> plugins/agento11y
  # rename: continue the version lineage from the old tag prefix.
  CURRENT=$(git tag -l 'plugins/sigil/v*' | sed 's|plugins/sigil/v||' | sort -V | tail -1)
  if [[ -n "$CURRENT" ]]; then
    # The changelog script also derives its previous tag from the
    # new prefix; point it at the old tag so the generated section
    # starts at the last pre-rename release instead of walking the
    # whole history.
    CHANGELOG_FROM="plugins/sigil/v${CURRENT}"
  fi
fi
CURRENT=${CURRENT:-0.0.0}

# Fail if the changelog is already ahead of the latest tag, so we
# don't re-emit a duplicate section after a previous tag step failed.
TOP=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-top-version.sh plugins/agento11y/CHANGELOG.md)
if [[ -n "$TOP" && "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$TOP" "$CURRENT" | sort -V | tail -1)" == "$TOP" && "$TOP" != "$CURRENT" ]]; then
  echo "::error::CHANGELOG top v${TOP} is ahead of the latest plugin tag v${CURRENT}; create the missing tag and retry."
  exit 1
fi

NEW=$(./.github/scripts/bump-version.sh "$BUMP" "$CURRENT")
echo "current=${CURRENT}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "new=${NEW}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "changelog_from=${CHANGELOG_FROM}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Update CHANGELOG.md
steps.run:
# Set (non-empty) only for the first post-rename release, where the
# previous tag lives under the old plugins/sigil/v* prefix. Guarded
# because an empty-but-set CHANGELOG_FROM means "walk from root".
PATHS=(plugins/agento11y)
if [[ -n "$LEGACY_FROM" ]]; then
  export CHANGELOG_FROM="$LEGACY_FROM"
  # Commits between the old tag and the rename touched
  # plugins/sigil, so walk the old path too or they'd be missing
  # from the section.
  PATHS+=(plugins/sigil)
fi
NEW_SECTION=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-for-release.sh "$NEW" plugins/agento11y "${PATHS[@]}")

# Prepend the new section to the existing changelog.
printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SECTION" | ./.github/scripts/prepend-changelog.sh plugins/agento11y/CHANGELOG.md

# Stash the section for the PR body and the run summary.
{
  echo 'section<<EOF'
  printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SECTION"
  echo 'EOF'
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{
  echo '## Release plan'
  echo ''
  echo "- bump: \`${BUMP}\`"
  echo "- current: \`v${CURRENT}\`"
  echo "- new: \`v${NEW}\`"
  echo "- dry-run: \`${DRY_RUN}\`"
  echo ''
  echo '### Changelog section'
  echo ''
  printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SECTION"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Build release PR body
steps.run:
{
  printf "Releases \`plugins/agento11y/v%s\`.

" "$NEW"
  printf '%s

' "$SECTION"
  printf '%s

' '---'
  printf "The tag \`plugins/agento11y/v%s\` will be created automatically by \`tag-agento11y-on-merge.yml\` when this PR merges into main.

" "$NEW"
  printf "Generated by \`.github/workflows/release-agento11y.yml\`.
"
} > /tmp/pr-body.md

pipelines.name: Publish SDK release notes

steps.name: Create release
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

VERSION="${TAG##*/v}"
PREFIX="${TAG%"/v${VERSION}"}"

CHANGELOG=$(jq -r --arg prefix "$PREFIX" \
  '.[] | select(.tag_prefix == $prefix) | .changelog' .github/sdk-releases.json)
if [[ -z "$CHANGELOG" ]]; then
  echo "::error::No .github/sdk-releases.json row has tag_prefix '${PREFIX}'."
  exit 1
fi

# The tag is created from the changelog, so a mismatch means the two
# have drifted and the notes would describe a different release.
TOP=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-top-version.sh "$CHANGELOG")
if [[ "$TOP" != "$VERSION" ]]; then
  echo "::error::${CHANGELOG} top version is ${TOP:+v}${TOP:-(none)}, but the pushed tag ${TAG} is v${VERSION}."
  exit 1
fi

./.github/scripts/changelog-latest-section.sh "$CHANGELOG" > /tmp/notes.md

# --latest=false keeps the "Latest" badge on the plugins/agento11y
# binary release, which plugins/agento11y/README.md and
# plugins/agento11y/scripts/install.sh send users to.
gh release create "$TAG" \
  --title "$TAG" \
  --notes-file /tmp/notes.md \
  --verify-tag \
  --latest=false

{
  echo "## Released \`${TAG}\`"
  echo ''
  cat /tmp/notes.md
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Setup Git
steps.run:
git config user.name 'grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]'

steps.name: Read top version from CHANGELOG.md
steps.run:
# First `## [X.Y.Z]` heading in the file is the just-released version.
VERSION=$(grep -m1 -oE '^## \[[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\]' plugins/agento11y/CHANGELOG.md || true)
VERSION=${VERSION#'## ['}
VERSION=${VERSION%']'}
if [[ -z "$VERSION" ]]; then
  echo "No \`## [X.Y.Z]\` heading found; nothing to tag."
  exit 0
fi
echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Create tag if missing
steps.run:
TAG="plugins/agento11y/v${VERSION}"
if git rev-parse "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Tag ${TAG} already exists; nothing to do."
  exit 0
fi
# The plugin was tagged under plugins/sigil/v* before the rename.
# A version already released under the old prefix must not be
# re-tagged (and re-released) under the new one — in particular
# the rename merge itself, which moves CHANGELOG.md with the
# already-released top version.
if git rev-parse "plugins/sigil/v${VERSION}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Version ${VERSION} already released as plugins/sigil/v${VERSION}; nothing to do."
  exit 0
fi
git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${REPO}.git"
git tag -a "$TAG" -m "plugins/agento11y ${VERSION}"
git push origin "$TAG"
echo "Created and pushed ${TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

pipelines.name: Tag SDK and plugin releases on merge

steps.name: Setup Git
steps.run:
git config user.name 'grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]'
git config user.email '144369747+grafana-plugins-platform-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

steps.name: Create missing tags
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${REPO}.git"

CREATED=()
FAILED=()

while read -r id; do
  CHANGELOG=$(jq -r --arg id "$id" '.[] | select(.id == $id) | .changelog' .github/sdk-releases.json)

  # Skip rather than fail, so a line that has never released does not
  # block the six that have.
  if [[ ! -f "$CHANGELOG" ]]; then
    echo "${id}: ${CHANGELOG} does not exist; nothing to tag."
    continue
  fi
  VERSION=$(./.github/scripts/changelog-top-version.sh "$CHANGELOG")
  if [[ -z "$VERSION" ]]; then
    echo "${id}: no \`## [X.Y.Z]\` heading found; nothing to tag."
    continue
  fi

  mapfile -t PREFIXES < <(
    jq -r --arg id "$id" \
      '.[] | select(.id == $id) | [.tag_prefix] + (.extra_tag_prefixes // []) | .[]' \
      .github/sdk-releases.json
  )

  for prefix in "${PREFIXES[@]}"; do
    TAG="${prefix}/v${VERSION}"
    # Ask the remote as well as the local clone. A tag pushed onto a
    # since-orphaned commit is not always reachable locally, but
    # pushing it again would still be rejected.
    if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/${TAG}" >/dev/null \
      || [[ -n "$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${TAG}")" ]]; then
      echo "${id}: tag ${TAG} already exists; nothing to do."
      continue
    fi
    git tag -a "$TAG" -m "${prefix} ${VERSION}"
    # A failed push must not abort the loop: rows run in table order,
    # so errexit here would always leave pi and opencode untagged.
    if git push origin "refs/tags/${TAG}"; then
      CREATED+=("$TAG")
    elif [[ -n "$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${TAG}")" ]]; then
      echo "${id}: tag ${TAG} was created by a concurrent run."
    else
      echo "::error::${id}: could not push tag ${TAG}."
      FAILED+=("$TAG")
    fi
  done
done < <(jq -r '.[].id' .github/sdk-releases.json)

if [[ ${#CREATED[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  {
    echo '## Tags created'
    echo ''
    for tag in "${CREATED[@]}"; do echo "- \`${tag}\`"; done
  } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
else
  echo 'No tags created; every changelog top version is already tagged.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi

if [[ ${#FAILED[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  {
    echo ''
    echo '## Tags that could not be pushed'
    echo ''
    for tag in "${FAILED[@]}"; do echo "- \`${tag}\`"; done
  } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  exit 1
fi
